en.askTitle: Change the dates, travellers and budget to get the same food-first Taipei plan for your trip
en.runTitle: Two friends from Kuala Lumpur, a food-first Taipei weekend on USD 700 each

fields.label: Arrival and departure airport and flight times
fields.value: Arrive Friday morning, leave Sunday night

fields.label: Budget and currency, excluding or including flights
fields.value: About USD 700 per person, excluding flights

fields.label: Room and bed needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. one room with two single beds

en.template: Plan a relaxed Taipei trip for {dates}, travelling from {origin} with {travellers}, {flights}, {budget} and {room}. Group food stops by area, label dated menus and estimated travel times, include rain and queue fallbacks, and protect the airport buffer. Show entry checks and a per-person budget. Plan only; do not book, contact, pay or submit forms.

phases.title: Check food shops, hotels, airport train fares and night-market hours for a trip a year away
phases.note: Menus and prices, hotel listings, airport train fares and night-market opening days
phases.judgment: A researcher took back its own earlier claim: a hotel rate it first called “official NT$4,500–7,500” could not be found again on the hotel’s working website, so it was replaced with a price it had actually opened, labelled as an old listing and not a 2027 quote.

phases.title: Draft the itinerary with hotels, transport, entry rules and the arrival card
phases.note: First draft of the route, hotels, transport and entry guidance

phases.title: Finish the checks on fares, food prices and hotel listings
Write the itinerary page and the dated source list
phases.note: Final itinerary page and a source list with access dates
phases.judgment: It would not borrow a stall’s fame for 2027: Fang Chia is described as a Michelin Bib Gourmand stop from the 2019 guide, labelled as a historical award that could not be confirmed as current.

phases.title: Check totals, dates and how the page looks in a clean browser
phases.judgment: It caught a date trap: Monday 25 October 2027 is a public holiday on the government’s calendar, so the weekend becomes a long one and the plan warns about busier queues and higher room prices.

workers: Looked for two or three hotels around Zhongshan with twin beds, and noted the price shown, the date it was shown and where
Found dated menu prices and opening hours for the breakfast shops, beef noodle shop and night-market snack stalls, and checked the Michelin Bib Gourmand listing

zh.askTitle: 改成你自己的日期、同行者和预算，得到同样以吃为主的台北行程
zh.runTitle: 来自吉隆坡的两位朋友，每人 700 美元的台北美食周末

fields.label: 同行者及护照、饮食需要
fields.value: 两位朋友，持马来西亚护照

fields.label: 抵离机场与航班时间
fields.value: 周五上午抵达，周日晚上离开

fields.label: 预算及币种、是否含机票
fields.value: 每人约 700 美元，不含机票

fields.label: 房间和床型需要
fields.placeholder: 例如：一间两张单人床的房间

zh.template: 请安排轻松的台北旅行：{dates}，从{origin}出发，同行者及护照、饮食需要{travellers}，抵离机场与航班时间{flights}，预算及币种、是否含机票{budget}，房间和床型需要{room}。按区域安排吃饭，标清菜单日期和交通估算，遇到雨天或排队要有替代方案，也要留够机场时间。列出入境核对事项和每人预算。只做计划，不预订、不联系、不付款、不提交表格。

phases.title: 核对美食店铺、酒店、机场捷运票价和夜市营业时间
phases.note: 菜单和价格、酒店报价、机场捷运票价、夜市营业日
phases.judgment: 一位同事撤回了自己先前的说法：它最初称酒店官方价格为“新台币 4,500–7,500 元”，但在酒店可正常访问的官网上无法再次找到，于是换成自己实际打开过的页面价格，并标明这是过去的报价、不是 2027 年的价格。

phases.title: 起草行程，含酒店、交通、入境规定和入台登记表
phases.note: 路线、酒店、交通和入境指引的初稿

phases.title: 补完票价、食物价格和酒店报价的核对
写出行程页面和标注查询日期的资料清单
phases.note: 最终行程页面，以及带查询日期的资料清单
phases.judgment: 它没有把一家摊位过去的名气搬到 2027 年：方家鸡肉饭被写成 2019 年米其林必比登推介的小吃，并标明这是历史奖项，无法确认现在仍在榜。

phases.title: 检查总额、日期，以及在干净浏览器里页面的显示
phases.judgment: 它发现了一个日期陷阱：2027 年 10 月 25 日(周一)在政府办公日历上是放假日，周末因此变成长周末，行程里提醒了排队更久、房价可能更高。

workers: 在中山一带找两三家有双床房的酒店，记下看到的价格、看到的日期和来源
查早餐店、牛肉面店和夜市小吃摊的带日期菜单价格与营业时间，并核对米其林必比登的收录情况
